findings.produced: GroupChatExecutor::with_database / GroupChatOrchestrator::with_database (both identical pub fn builders taking Arc<StateDatabase>)
findings.consumer_location: zero call sites. Executor::persist_turn (executor.rs:156) reads `self.db` and silently no-ops on None. Startup at src/bin/aleph-server/commands/start/mod.rs:3033 wires only `GroupChatExecutor::new(handle).with_coordinator_visible(...).with_history_window(...)` — neither with_database nor with_provider_registry is ever invoked.
findings.rationale: Both with_database builders are declared pub but never called anywhere in src/, tests/, or interfaces/. They are inert scaffolding: the underlying fields (`executor.db`, `orchestrator.db`) start as None and silently no-op the persistence. The design intent is turn-persistence to StateDatabase, but the wiring is severed. Two paths: (a) CONNECT — wire at startup by plumbing the existing StateDatabase into both builders (single trait addition); (b) CUT — delete both builder methods + their fields + persist_turn if no caller is on the roadmap. Recommend CUT: the DB turn-persistence code path exists, but if no caller wants it, it's dead scaffolding that future readers will mistake for a working feature. The `db` field on orchestrator is even more clearly dead (never read).
findings.residual_risk: If kept dormant: any operator who configures `GroupChatConfig::history_window_rounds` expects conversation history to land in StateDatabase; the silent skip will surprise them. Deleting requires checking whether turn-persistence is on the near-term roadmap.

findings.consumer_location: Zero external call sites (only tests at executor.rs:994, :1166). At runtime, executor.provider_registry starts as None (executor.rs:60) and resolve_provider (executor.rs:107) silently falls back to default_provider whenever a persona specifies provider = Some(...).
findings.rationale: Per-persona provider override is a designed feature (PersonaConfig::provider at config/types/group_chat.rs:115, Persona::provider at group_chat/protocol.rs:72), but the wiring from startup to executor is missing. The `provider` field on persona is honored by the executor only when with_provider_registry has been called — at startup it isn't, so the entire feature is dormant. Two paths: (a) CONNECT — share the existing ProviderRegistry used by gateway/execution_engine/engine.rs:147 with GroupChatExecutor::new at startup; (b) CUT — delete the provider field on Persona/PersonaConfig, the with_provider_registry builder, and the provider_registry field. Recommend DECIDE: this is a product call. The painless-wire heuristic argues CUT (no observed production pain, no example config uses per-persona provider), but the persona field is in the public config schema so removing it is a breaking change.
findings.residual_risk: If kept dormant: silently ignores per-persona provider overrides. Any user with `provider = "anthropic"` on a persona will see all personas use the same default — no warning, just wrong behavior.

findings.consumer_location: Zero production call sites. Only used in #[cfg(test)] blocks at orchestrator.rs:384, :435, :460, :496, :504, :548, :552, :555, :621.
findings.rationale: Pure test-only API. Demoting to `pub(crate)` would break the tests (which live in the same module, so `pub(crate)` is fine; or move tests to use a private helper). Either way, the public API of GroupChatOrchestrator does not need to expose a snapshot of all sessions — callers query by id (get_session) or mutate (end_session). Recommend demoting to pub(crate) or moving tests to use an internal `fn sessions_snapshot(&self)` helper.

findings.consumer_location: Only build_history_text_windowed (session.rs:196 — same file, internal helper) and tests (session.rs:351). The windowed variant is what production uses (executor.rs:249).
findings.rationale: Helper-of-a-helper. The windowed version calls this when window_rounds is 0 (the default-disables-window case), which is the only remaining live caller. Could be inlined into build_history_text_windowed (a 4-line helper) or kept as a private fn. Recommend demoting to pub(crate) or inlining.

findings.consumer_location: zero call sites anywhere — neither production code nor tests use either method.
findings.rationale: Pure form-1 dead code. The other four CRUD methods on this module (insert_group_chat_session, update_group_chat_session_status, insert_group_chat_turn, get_group_chat_turns) each have exactly one production caller. These two have zero. Either connect them (group_chat_orchestrator uses get_group_chat_session_owner for ownership check, and list_active_group_chats powers a `group_chat.list` admin RPC) or delete them. Recommend DECIDE if there's an active roadmap for an admin/listing RPC; otherwise CUT.
findings.residual_risk: Trivial — pure SQL helper, no live callers.
